issues.description: In the solution, create_controlled_single_qubit_gate calls create_single_qubit_gate with the first argument set to the control index (e.g. create_single_qubit_gate(control, ...)), whereas the create_single_qubit_gate function signature and problem description treat the first parameter as the total number of qubits in the system (num_qubits). This re-interpretation of the first parameter is not documented and changes its intended semantics, which can confuse students about how to call create_single_qubit_gate and how sub-DDs (e.g., identity on c qubits) are constructed.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify and unify the semantics of the first parameter of create_single_qubit_gate across the problem statement, template, and solution. Either (A) document that the first parameter may also be used to build smaller sub-DDs (i.e., it can denote the number of qubits of a sub-block) and add helper functions/wrappers for building I^(c), or (B) change create_controlled_single_qubit_gate to pass the total num_qubits when calling create_single_qubit_gate and then construct the control block explicitly. Ensure examples and documentation consistently show the intended use.
